title: Mate with Two Rooks
subtitle: The ladder mate — walk the king to the edge.
goals: Cut the king off with one rook
Alternate checks like climbing a ladder
Keep the rooks safe from the king

steps.say: Two rooks checkmate a lone king without any help from your own king. The method is called the LADDER: one rook fences the king in, the other gives check, pushing him back rank by rank until he runs out of board.

autoMoves.say: Check! The king must leave the fifth rank — and can never return: the rook holds it.
The second rung. See the pattern? The rooks take turns.
Uh oh — the king attacks our rook...
...so it simply slides across. Same rank, same fence, but far out of the king's reach. The ladder continues.

steps.prompt: One rook already fences rank 4. Start the ladder — check the king off rank 5!
hints: The a4 rook is the fence — it must stay. Which rook is free to give check?
Bring the b1 rook up to the fifth rank.

line.say: Check! The king retreats — and the b5 rook becomes the new fence while the a4 rook prepares the next rung.

rejections.say: Wrong rook! Your fence just left rank 4 — the king can walk right back down through it. Keep the fence, check with the OTHER rook.

steps.wrongSay: One rook holds the fence on rank 4; the other must deliver the check on rank 5.
steps.successSay: Fence and hammer — each rook takes a turn at each job.

steps.prompt: The king attacks your b6 rook! Save it — without breaking the fence.
hints: The rook must stay ON the sixth rank to keep the fence — but get out of the king's reach.
Slide it all the way across the board. Distance is safety.

line.say: All the way across — the fence holds, and the king can never catch a rook working from the far side.
Far out of reach — the fence holds and the ladder is ready to continue.

rejections.say: Kxd6! You stayed on the right rank but within the king's reach. Slide FAR — the rook works the same from h6.
The rook is safe... but you abandoned the sixth rank. The fence is broken and the king strolls forward. Keep rooks on their rank, far away.

steps.wrongSay: Stay on the sixth rank — just as far from the king as possible.
steps.successSay: That sidestep is the only 'trick' in this whole mate. The rest is pure ladder.

steps.prompt: The king is on his last rank. Finish the ladder — checkmate in one!
hints: The a7 rook already seals rank 7 — the king can't step down.
Deliver the final check on the eighth rank, from a safe distance.

line.say: Checkmate! The final rung: check on the eighth, fence on the seventh, and the king is out of board. The full ladder, mastered.

rejections.say: Check — but your fence left rank 7 and the king escapes to d7! In the ladder, the fence NEVER moves until the other rook has checked.

steps.wrongSay: Fence on seven stays; the h6 rook strikes on eight — from far away so the king can't touch it.
steps.successSay: Two rooks, zero help from your king. You can now finish any game where you're two rooks up!
